about: Rival personas for race/tools/rival_gen.py. Global knobs only: never tune per course. DAWG flies the optimizer's best line at its fixed envelopeFrac. Every other persona is anchored to DAWG's time on the same course: target = DAWG time x ladder.ratios[persona] (ONE global table), and rival_personas.solve_pace() derives that persona's speedCap (then envelopeFrac, up to DAWG's) per course to land on it. envelopeFrac/speedCap below are the solver's starting points, not tuning. gateWindow is the usable fraction of each gate radius (at most 0.9: a line never grazes a gate edge).

personas.name: STEVE
personas.blurb: Sunday driver: flies every gate dead centre, the slowest rung of the ladder.

personas.name: BRAT
personas.blurb: Fast, sloppy: halfway to the optimal line, and runs wide on 2 gates every lap.

personas.name: MOO
personas.blurb: Fully optimized line inside the middle 60% of each gate.

personas.name: DAWG
personas.blurb: Fully optimized, 98% of the envelope, but never uses the outer 30% of a gate. Humans can.
